campaign_logline: Navigate the graveyard of the Zenith sector where Aurelia's silence is deafening and Vanguard's steel is cold.
opening_situation: You arrive at Zenith, a derelict hub. Kaelen greets you via a flickering holo-link. She claims the Aurelia fleet vanished into 'the static'.
main_mystery: What caused the Aurelia signals to invert into a permanent loop of distress calls?
act_1_outline: Secure the Zenith perimeter from scavengers.
Decode the first Aurelia data-packet near Vanguard outpost.
Identify why Kaelen's signal remains stable while the local grid decays.
long_term_reveal: The 'static' is a deliberate quarantine of a subspace anomaly that cannot be closed, only bypassed.
kaelen_rule: Kaelen is immortal; her mystery remains partially veiled. She knows more than she shares.
faction_reveal_rule: New factions are only revealed via gate travel to new systems.
humor_rule: Dry, dark PG-13 humor. No catchphrases. Avoid repetitive jokes about space-vacuum life.
address_rule: Keep all narrative beats under 140 characters for UI display.
fallback_rule: If a prompt is ambiguous, default to 'System Error' flavored as localized tech glitches.
story_horizon_rule: Trigger expansion when the player reaches specific progression milestones.

story_arcs.name: The Vanguard Protocol
story_arcs.summary: Investigate the military's failed attempt to contain the Aurelia signal breach.

rumor_trails.name: Ghost Frequency
clue_templates: A frequency pulse recorded near the core.
An encrypted log from a pilot who 'saw' the fold.
rumor_trails.payoff: Unlock the 'Void-Walker' title and a unique ship skin.

regeneration_triggers.description: When a major arc concludes, generate a new horizon for the next system.

expansion_rules: Append new horizons without retconning past choices.
New systems must introduce unique ores and faction-specific tech.
